description_en: Creates a category by calling CreateCategory
name: CreateCategory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent category. If this parameter is not specified, the category is created as a level-1 category by default
parameters.help_zh: 上级类⽬Id，不填是默认为⼀级类⽬
parameters.name: parent_category_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

CategoryId.description_en: The category ID. The ID is generated by the system and is globally unique. It is the unique identifier used to access category data
CategoryId.description_zh: 类⽬ID，由系统⽣成，全局唯 ⼀。是访问类⽬数据的唯⼀标识

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:
true: The operation is successful.
false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh: 是否操作成功，成功：true，失败：false
